title: Projection cache storage
responsibility: Provide disposable projection caching in R2 or an in-memory fallback.

inputs.name: hubCache.bucket
inputs.description: Optional R2 bucket; omission creates a fresh per-call memory cache.

outputs.name: hubCache
outputs.description: Cache get/put/delete methods. R2 uses a projections prefix and stores identity/hash metadata, treating read failures as misses and swallowing put/delete failures. Memory puts clone entries and gets return the retained entry or null.
